title: Strong Converse Exponents of Quantum Soft Covering and Privacy Amplification
summary: We determine the exact strong converse exponent of quantum soft covering under the sandwiched R{é}nyi divergence for all orders $α\in[\frac{1}{2},\infty)$. For $α\in[\frac{1}{2},1)$, the exponent is characterized by the two-parameter club-sandwiched mutual information, whereas for $α\in[1,\infty)$, it is characterized by the order-$α$ sandwiched R{é}nyi mutual information.
